response.sql:
WITH status_rates AS (
  SELECT
    si.healtheval AS status,
    SUM(sc.scancount) AS total_scans,
    AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS gb_per_minute
  FROM scans AS sc
  JOIN sites AS si ON si.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref
  GROUP BY si.healtheval
), compared AS (
  SELECT
    status,
    total_scans,
    gb_per_minute,
    AVG(gb_per_minute) OVER () AS average_gb_per_minute
  FROM status_rates
)
SELECT
  status,
  total_scans,
  gb_per_minute,
  gb_per_minute - average_gb_per_minute AS above_average
FROM compared
WHERE gb_per_minute > average_gb_per_minute;

assumptions.assumption: GB per minute for a status is the average of each scan’s gbsize/spanmin ratio; scans missing either value or with zero duration do not contribute. The comparison average gives each status with a defined rate equal weight.

alternatives.interpretation: Use each status’s total GB divided by its total scanning minutes, excluding scans missing either value or with zero duration; then compare those status rates using an unweighted average across statuses.
alternatives.sql:
WITH status_rates AS (
  SELECT
    si.healtheval AS status,
    SUM(sc.scancount) AS total_scans,
    1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin <> 0 THEN sc.gbsize END)
      / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin <> 0 THEN sc.spanmin END), 0) AS gb_per_minute
  FROM scans AS sc
  JOIN sites AS si ON si.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref
  GROUP BY si.healtheval
), compared AS (
  SELECT status, total_scans, gb_per_minute,
         AVG(gb_per_minute) OVER () AS average_gb_per_minute
  FROM status_rates
)
SELECT status, total_scans, gb_per_minute,
       gb_per_minute - average_gb_per_minute AS above_average
FROM compared
WHERE gb_per_minute > average_gb_per_minute;
